title: What's it actually like living near Harvard Square?
snippet: Long-running resident discussion thread with mixed opinions: some love the walkability and energy, others cite noise and tourist crowds.
full_text: A long-running community forum thread on living near Harvard Square shows mixed resident sentiment: many praise the walkability, transit access, and constant activity, while others cite tourist crowds, weekend noise, and rising rents as recurring frustrations.
claim_text: Community sentiment about living near Harvard Square is mixed: residents frequently cite walkability and energy as positives, and tourist crowds, noise, and rising rents as recurring complaints.
